author: ImNotYourTiger
body:
Hey
So baisically this is about my most recent warn which is saying "Be respectful to others". Me and Gummi were having an argument and I was talking to MyWorld and some other people and Gummi kept harassing me. If you don't believe me, feel free to ask a staff member, even Jahaj. Me and Gummi are good now, so I wouldn't recommend going to him and telling him about this, since this will  start a pointless argument between me and him. I would just like to know why I got a warn, since I didn't say anything harsh. MyWorld could be a witness or maybe some other staff (Jahaj or Resepignev I think were there aswell). Thanks for listening, hopefully something will be done :) 
Regards,
-Tiger
